source_SASS_policy: One record per original SASS; unchanged original SM89 header and full64 NVBit original function PC. Existing source trace prefix remains, no fake opcode or PC.
prefix: PC mask dst_count typed_dsts opcode src_count typed_srcs memory_width compressed_memory_addresses immediate
suffix: per-effective-lane dynamic constant offsets when bank>=0
texture_kind_0: No trailing texture fields; all non-texture instructions use original ADA8 typed/constant/control semantics.
texture_kind_1_rules: Exact opcode TLD.SCR.B.LZ only; full static SASS and PLR operand classes/widths must match actual loaded module.
Single context/lifetime, one texture generation1, one kernel/grid1/block37 in this initial candidate; distinct scope from general texture assets.
Actual API descriptor resType LINEAR, unsigned32x1,point filter,flags0,null view; full raw resource/texture descriptor bytes and named fields retained.
API entire handle >0 and <=UINT32, each observed handle32 equals entire API handle; no invented high-half read.
Each effective lane signed index >=0 and index <resource_bytes/4; no address arithmetic overflow; resolved prefix address exactly base+4*index.
Width4 for an effective texture request; no constant bank or control kind on TLD. Zero effective mask generates no memory request and no texture destination write.
Implicit UR descriptor/high-half and all ordinary CBANK/dynamic offsets remain the complete frozen-v8 typed contract. Observer PRE snapshots are not substituted for missing operands or load results.

consumer_route.cache_path: Existing Core L1T/texture cache with actual TEXTURE_ACC_R requests; no global LDG rewrite
consumer_route.numerical: Same-process actual GPU reference; trace-driven consumer does not recompute numerical values

producer_ABI_plan: Keep existing common record/call ABI dimensions; private is_mem4 packs dynamic index/handle in existing address64 slot. New inject source/SO/version9 is frozen independently; old55,c8,v8 unchanged.
existing_qualifications: Source observer full-descriptor V2 SHA830701... provides narrow address proof only; not convertible to a complete standard trace.

zero_effective_mask.resource_base_bytes_handle_generation: Retain actual nonzero API descriptor values unchanged; metadata does not imply a request

integer_contract.pair_high32: Entire actual API handle; <=UINT32_MAX,not a VA
integer_contract.pair_low32: Two-complement signed int32 index encoding; high-bit set is negative and rejected for effective lanes
integer_contract.offset_arithmetic: Validate signed index inbounds before zero-extending to uint64 and multiplying by4. Do not use overflowing signed32 multiplication. Require base+offset and base+resource_bytes to remain representable uint64.
